_comment: Interaction-stance badge + transition SFX (see include/InteractionMode.h). Your MOVEMENT is the stance: walking = Observe (slow down to notice), running (Shift) = Act (move with intent to do). A persistent corner badge shows the current stance; a distinct sound plays entering Act vs returning to Observe. x/y are window fractions (bottom-left corner by default). Colors are RGBA 0..1. Sounds are placeholders (both point at observe.ogg, pitched apart) until final cues are authored. Tunable -- edit + relaunch (dev reads assets from source).
